answer: Escrowed deposits plus a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. A newcomer locks 60 units for 20 epochs and names its referrer, so no identity hides behind a basalt wall. Making 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 units, far above their split reward, while one honest agent pays 60 once and keeps undiluted rewards, like a lotus.
